text:
Willow planning notes (3–10 Nov) cover about 26 modules. Final corrected values: catalog ttl_s 390, session ttl_s 330, upload batch_size 700, scheduler max_workers 14 and batch_size 400, reports max_workers 14, gateway ttl_s 180, metrics timeout_s 55, auth ttl_s 240.

Ownership: audit, quota, and ingest go to worker gamma; search, billing, and sync go to delta; shipping goes to alpha; inventory goes to beta. Separation of duties keeps billing and profile, profile and search, and pricing and shipping on different workers, and metrics and quota apart.

Dependency rules: no path from archive to media, reports to scheduler, pricing to reports, or gateway to indexer. Client requirements: archive queue_depth 450, quota max_workers 20, ingest max_workers 16, search batch_size 400.

Rollout: shipping and session must precede indexer. Other decisions: the security review is at month end, no Rust rewrites this quarter, the linter is undecided, code review turnaround stays under a day, and the budget review moved to next Thursday.
